title: Infinite Race
ratingBasis: One key state/reset observation with linear event processing;rough CF1500 calibration.
priorityReason: Compact event-state modelling teaches how repeated overtaking forces a new lap;good practice after basic simulations.
learningObjective: Compact event-state modelling teaches how repeated overtaking forces a new lap;good practice after basic simulations.

title: Bouquet
ratingBasis: Local compatibility DP plus delayed activation/range queries needs several coordinated ideas;rough CF2300.
priorityReason: A useful bridge from quadratic DP to scheduled updates and range maxima;subtasks expose why simple greedy is insufficient.
learningObjective: A useful bridge from quadratic DP to scheduled updates and range maxima;subtasks expose why simple greedy is insufficient.

title: Bikeparking
ratingBasis: Non-obvious matching order plus aggregated large counts raises difficulty beyond standard two-pointer matching;rough CF2300.
priorityReason: Good exchange-argument and batched matching practice;more specialized than basic greedy scheduling.
learningObjective: Good exchange-argument and batched matching practice;more specialized than basic greedy scheduling.

title: Carnival General
ratingBasis: Turning local ranking restrictions into an always-valid ordering is the main observation;quadratic input permits direct construction;rough CF1900.
priorityReason: Builds confidence in constructive existence arguments and incremental arrangements without advanced data structures.
learningObjective: Builds confidence in constructive existence arguments and incremental arrangements without advanced data structures.

title: Candy
ratingBasis: Large candy values rule out naive value-indexed knapsack;cost-based DP modelling is the challenge;rough CF2300.
priorityReason: Connects adjacent-swap movement costs to selecting a fixed-size subset,then choosing a useful DP dimension.
learningObjective: Connects adjacent-swap movement costs to selecting a fixed-size subset,then choosing a useful DP dimension.

title: Data Centers
ratingBasis: Repeated top-prefix decrements at large n require more care than full re-sorting each time;rough CF2200,without claiming an audited optimal implementation.
priorityReason: Useful practice in maintaining a repeatedly modified sorted multiset and comparing simulation costs across subtasks.
learningObjective: Useful practice in maintaining a repeatedly modified sorted multiset and comparing simulation costs across subtasks.

title: Luna likes Love
ratingBasis: Recognizing the overlap count is the main step,followed by a standard logarithmic sweep;rough CF2100.
priorityReason: An excellent reduction from adjacent swaps/removals to counting crossing pairs with an active-position Fenwick tree.
learningObjective: An excellent reduction from adjacent swaps/removals to counting crossing pairs with an active-position Fenwick tree.

title: Railway
ratingBasis: Algebraic interval transformation plus binary search over sorted tunnels;rough CF1800.
priorityReason: Turns physical meeting times into interval inequalities and emphasizes strict boundaries without floating-point arithmetic.
learningObjective: Turns physical meeting times into interval inequalities and emphasizes strict boundaries without floating-point arithmetic.

title: Ferris Wheel
ratingBasis: Simple necessary extreme-value conditions and a linear ordering construction;rough CF1400.
priorityReason: Accessible circular construction practice using order constraints and extreme elements;good transition from checking to building.
learningObjective: Accessible circular construction practice using order constraints and extreme elements;good transition from checking to building.

title: Watering Plants
ratingBasis: Only neighboring comparisons change after an update,but timestamp accounting and day boundaries need care;rough CF1700.
priorityReason: Teaches event-driven accounting:accumulate elapsed time only when a local condition changes instead of simulating every resident daily.
learningObjective: Teaches event-driven accounting:accumulate elapsed time only when a local condition changes instead of simulating every resident daily.

title: Cakes
ratingBasis: Equal maximum frequencies across all groups require a global feasibility observation and efficient repeated queries;rough CF2100.
priorityReason: Useful counting and integer-division feasibility practice with many queries;best after simpler frequency-distribution problems.
learningObjective: Useful counting and integer-division feasibility practice with many queries;best after simpler frequency-distribution problems.

title: Superpiece
ratingBasis: Multiple combined move sets and unbounded coordinates create substantial casework beyond ordinary grid BFS;rough CF2500.
priorityReason: Offers advanced move-set classification and parity/distance reasoning,but extensive chess-specific cases make it enrichment rather than core practice.
learningObjective: Offers advanced move-set classification and parity/distance reasoning,but extensive chess-specific cases make it enrichment rather than core practice.

title: Toy Design
ratingBasis: Reconstructing components under a query budget with versioned merges is a substantial strategy-design task;rough CF2500.
priorityReason: Develops connectivity equivalence and information-gathering strategies with persistent hypothetical graph designs;useful interactive enrichment.
learningObjective: Develops connectivity equivalence and information-gathering strategies with persistent hypothetical graph designs;useful interactive enrichment.

title: Padel Prize Pursuit
ratingBasis: Large event counts plus repeated transfers and cumulative-holder tie rules require careful aggregation;rough CF2600.
priorityReason: Bulk ownership transfers and duration aggregation teach why per-item simulation can be too expensive;suited to advanced merging practice.
learningObjective: Bulk ownership transfers and duration aggregation teach why per-item simulation can be too expensive;suited to advanced merging practice.

title: Find the Box
ratingBasis: A basic accepted search differs greatly from full-score query optimization;rough CF2900 for strong/full-score strategy,not just any positive score.
priorityReason: Creative query construction and learning from blocked robot motion provide strong enrichment,but scored query minimization is specialized.
learningObjective: Creative query construction and learning from blocked robot motion provide strong enrichment,but scored query minimization is specialized.

title: Twin Cookies
ratingBasis: Distinct ordered values,uncontrolled replies and equal-sum disjoint subsets require a nontrivial constructive strategy;rough CF2400.
priorityReason: Teaches adversarial-response construction and equal-sum invariants under a small query budget;useful after simpler interactive tasks.
learningObjective: Teaches adversarial-response construction and equal-sum invariants under a small query budget;useful after simpler interactive tasks.

title: Boat
ratingBasis: Interval compression and counting multiple increasing choices within intervals are substantially harder than basic LIS counting;rough CF2600.
priorityReason: Counting increasing choices from value intervals is useful combinatorial DP enrichment after ordinary subsequence counting.
learningObjective: Counting increasing choices from value intervals is useful combinatorial DP enrichment after ordinary subsequence counting.

title: Gap
ratingBasis: The key maximum-gap lower bound enables efficient bucket queries;rough CF2100 for a strong query-cost strategy.
priorityReason: A concise pigeonhole/bucketing lesson:use extrema queries to avoid recovering every hidden number.
learningObjective: A concise pigeonhole/bucketing lesson:use extrema queries to avoid recovering every hidden number.

title: Fireworks
ratingBasis: Representing absolute-cost functions compactly and merging them across a tree requires advanced convex-DP insight;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: A valuable advanced example of convex piecewise-linear tree DP and merging breakpoints,but too specialized for the core sequence.
learningObjective: A valuable advanced example of convex piecewise-linear tree DP and merging breakpoints,but too specialized for the core sequence.

title: Travelling Merchant
ratingBasis: Trade-profit preprocessing plus a profit-per-time decision transformation and cycle detection;rough CF2500.
priorityReason: Connects all-pairs shortest paths with ratio optimization and profitable-cycle feasibility;reusable advanced graph modelling.
learningObjective: Connects all-pairs shortest paths with ratio optimization and profitable-cycle feasibility;reusable advanced graph modelling.

title: Koala Game
ratingBasis: Several hidden-permutation objectives and tight round budgets require more than standard comparison queries;rough CF3000 for strong/full-score strategies.
priorityReason: Good advanced information-gathering practice through an optimizing adversary,but its many scored subtasks make it specialized enrichment.
learningObjective: Good advanced information-gathering practice through an optimizing adversary,but its many scored subtasks make it specialized enrichment.

title: Land of the Rainbow Gold
ratingBasis: Rectangle component queries after a connected grid walk need a non-obvious planar counting reduction and range data structures;rough CF3100.
priorityReason: Teaches how planar connectivity can become geometric range counting;advanced enrichment rather than a prerequisite problem.
learningObjective: Teaches how planar connectivity can become geometric range counting;advanced enrichment rather than a prerequisite problem.

title: Bridges
ratingBasis: Weight updates combined with threshold component-size queries require separating stable and changing edges;rough CF2700.
priorityReason: A strong bridge from static offline DSU to dynamic threshold connectivity through batching and temporary changes.
learningObjective: A strong bridge from static offline DSU to dynamic threshold connectivity through batching and temporary changes.

title: Strange Device
ratingBasis: Deriving the effective period via gcd and merging wrapped intervals is harder than routine modular arithmetic;rough CF2300.
priorityReason: Combines modular periodicity and interval-union counting,with useful attention to very large integers and overflow.
learningObjective: Combines modular periodicity and interval-union counting,with useful attention to very large integers and overflow.

title: Street Lamps
ratingBasis: Cumulative historical connectivity under toggles is much harder than checking current range state;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: Develops time-integrated connectivity queries and event-based aggregation;useful after standard offline range techniques.
learningObjective: Develops time-integrated connectivity queries and event-based aggregation;useful after standard offline range techniques.

title: Painting Walls
ratingBasis: Efficiently recognizing allowed rotations and then minimizing interval cover needs coordinated matching and covering ideas;rough CF2600.
priorityReason: Separates finding valid cyclic pattern placements from covering a line with as few valid intervals as possible.
learningObjective: Separates finding valid cyclic pattern placements from covering a line with as few valid intervals as possible.

title: Fun Tour
ratingBasis: An unknown bounded-degree tree,query budget and monotone consecutive-distance permutation create a demanding constructive task;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: Offers challenging tree-centroid/distance construction with limited information;useful enrichment after standard tree metrics.
learningObjective: Offers challenging tree-centroid/distance construction with limited information;useful enrichment after standard tree metrics.

title: Rainforest Jumps
ratingBasis: Choosing endpoints as well as lifting along nearest-higher transitions requires several structural observations;rough CF2800.
priorityReason: Extends nearest-greater-element preprocessing to fast interval-to-interval minimum-jump queries;valuable advanced lifting practice.
learningObjective: Extends nearest-greater-element preprocessing to fast interval-to-interval minimum-jump queries;valuable advanced lifting practice.

title: Road Closures
ratingBasis: One fixed-budget tree DP is approachable,but all budgets at large n demand substantially stronger aggregation;rough CF3200 for the full task.
priorityReason: A rich extension of degree-constrained tree DP to all degree budgets;useful once ordinary tree state transitions are familiar.
learningObjective: A rich extension of degree-constrained tree DP to all degree budgets;useful once ordinary tree state transitions are familiar.

title: Permutation
ratingBasis: Constructing exactly a requested count is easier with long output;the full-score short-length limit adds the main challenge;rough CF2600.
priorityReason: Connects increasing-subsequence counting with arithmetic construction and binary representations;good inverse-counting practice.
learningObjective: Connects increasing-subsequence counting with arithmetic construction and binary representations;good inverse-counting practice.

title: Cyberland
ratingBasis: Reset/halving effects,repeat visits and a large operation budget complicate the graph model;rough CF2700.
priorityReason: Teaches shortest-path state expansion and reasoning about operations that modify accumulated cost;useful beyond ordinary additive paths.
learningObjective: Teaches shortest-path state expansion and reasoning about operations that modify accumulated cost;useful beyond ordinary additive paths.

title: Railroad Trip
ratingBasis: Recognizing travel counts as interval updates avoids simulating each route;the remaining minimum-cost choice is direct;rough CF1500.
priorityReason: A clear real-world use of range-add frequency counting,followed by independent per-edge cost choices.
learningObjective: A clear real-world use of range-add frequency counting,followed by independent per-edge cost choices.

title: Cake 2
ratingBasis: Circular interval duplication and turn-dependent transitions at quadratic scale;rough CF2000.
priorityReason: Good interval-DP practice on a circle with one deterministic greedy opponent;clarifies whose turn belongs in a state.
learningObjective: Good interval-DP practice on a circle with one deterministic greedy opponent;clarifies whose turn belongs in a state.

title: JOI Park
ratingBasis: Distance-based activation and incremental edge-cost accounting require an extra modelling step after Dijkstra;rough CF2000.
priorityReason: Combines single-source shortest paths with a threshold sweep over costs;useful practice beyond returning one distance array.
learningObjective: Combines single-source shortest paths with a threshold sweep over costs;useful practice beyond returning one distance array.

title: Ball
ratingBasis: Optimizing a final survivor with partly fixed initial positions needs non-obvious process compression and feasibility reasoning;rough CF2800.
priorityReason: Interesting threshold reasoning through repeated median-like elimination,but the unusual queue process makes it specialized enrichment.
learningObjective: Interesting threshold reasoning through repeated median-like elimination,but the unusual queue process makes it specialized enrichment.

title: Oranges
ratingBasis: Bounded final-group length permits direct DP with incremental extrema;rough CF1600.
priorityReason: A friendly partition-DP exercise:extend the last box while updating its minimum and maximum.
learningObjective: A friendly partition-DP exercise:extend the last box while updating its minimum and maximum.

title: Collecting Stamps 2
ratingBasis: Maximizing JOI triples after one insertion needs several reusable counts and 64-bit arithmetic;rough CF1800.
priorityReason: Teaches prefix/suffix subsequence counts and separating the contribution of one inserted character.
learningObjective: Teaches prefix/suffix subsequence counts and separating the contribution of one inserted character.

title: Train Fare
ratingBasis: Many edge price increases make repeated shortest paths too costly;preserving original-distance reachability is the key modelling challenge;rough CF2400.
priorityReason: Uses the original shortest-path layers to reason about monotone fare changes;valuable after BFS and offline processing.
learningObjective: Uses the original shortest-path layers to reason about monotone fare changes;valuable after BFS and offline processing.

title: Territory
ratingBasis: Huge repetition count rules out direct simulation and requires grouping translated point occurrences and square conditions;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: Develops translation invariants for an extremely long repeated walk;specialized geometry enrichment rather than core simulation.
learningObjective: Develops translation invariants for an extremely long repeated walk;specialized geometry enrichment rather than core simulation.

title: Foehn Phenomena
ratingBasis: Track a piecewise contribution of each height difference and update endpoints carefully;rough CF1500.
priorityReason: An excellent example where a range update changes only two adjacent differences;strong preparation for more complex range problems.
learningObjective: An excellent example where a range update changes only two adjacent differences;strong preparation for more complex range problems.

title: Semiexpress
ratingBasis: Choosing extra stops across express intervals under a time budget needs arithmetic batching and greedy gain selection;rough CF2500.
priorityReason: Teaches allocation by marginal gains across independent line segments with a very large implicit coordinate range.
learningObjective: Teaches allocation by marginal gains across independent line segments with a very large implicit coordinate range.

title: Kingdom of JOIOI
ratingBasis: Connectivity and row/column contiguity constrain possible cuts;turning spread minimization into an efficient check is nontrivial;rough CF2600.
priorityReason: A good advanced decision-problem transformation with monotone grid boundaries and symmetry handling.
learningObjective: A good advanced decision-problem transformation with monotone grid boundaries and symmetry handling.

title: Soccer
ratingBasis: Several action modes and long-distance kicks need compact state modelling before Dijkstra is practical;rough CF2800.
priorityReason: Teaches expanded shortest-path states by separating carrying,motion and kicking modes instead of tracking every player configuration.
learningObjective: Teaches expanded shortest-path states by separating carrying,motion and kicking modes instead of tracking every player configuration.

title: Stove
ratingBasis: Sorting gaps and selecting the largest savings is one core observation;rough CF1200.
priorityReason: A clean introductory greedy problem:decide which idle gaps are worth separating with a limited number of activations.
learningObjective: A clean introductory greedy problem:decide which idle gaps are worth separating with a limited number of activations.

title: Art Exhibition
ratingBasis: Positive values justify filling gaps after sorting,then an algebraic sweep removes quadratic enumeration;rough CF1700.
priorityReason: Turns a subset objective with a size-range penalty into a sorted interval and running best prefix expression.
learningObjective: Turns a subset objective with a size-range penalty into a sorted interval and running best prefix expression.

title: Dango Maker
ratingBasis: Recognizing diagonal conflict structure rather than using generic grid matching is the principal insight;rough CF2400.
priorityReason: Shows how an apparently two-dimensional packing conflict can be decomposed into narrow dependencies for DP.
learningObjective: Shows how an apparently two-dimensional packing conflict can be decomposed into narrow dependencies for DP.

title: Snake Escaping
ratingBasis: Wildcard queries at million-query scale and a tight memory limit require combining subset/superset sums with small-side enumeration;rough CF2900.
priorityReason: A useful advanced subset-transform problem that rewards choosing among complementary query representations.
learningObjective: A useful advanced subset-transform problem that rewards choosing among complementary query representations.

title: Bitaro the Brave
ratingBasis: For each anchor,multiply rightward and downward counts while scanning the grid;rough CF1400.
priorityReason: Accessible grid counting with independent row/column choices;good practice replacing nested enumeration with suffix counts.
learningObjective: Accessible grid counting with independent row/column choices;good practice replacing nested enumeration with suffix counts.

title: Exhibition
ratingBasis: Sorting values and allocating frame capacities must preserve extendibility,not just fit each picture independently;rough CF2100.
priorityReason: Practices matching ordered resources to items while respecting two monotone criteria;useful after simpler frame/item greedy tasks.
learningObjective: Practices matching ordered resources to items while respecting two monotone criteria;useful after simpler frame/item greedy tasks.

title: Growing Vegetables is Fun 3
ratingBasis: Three color counts plus last color and movement costs form a larger DP than ordinary string rearrangement;rough CF2500.
priorityReason: Connects stable ordering of equal symbols,adjacent-swap cost and count-based sequence-building DP.
learningObjective: Connects stable ordering of equal symbols,adjacent-swap cost and count-based sequence-building DP.

title: Unique Cities
ratingBasis: All-root unique-distance layers plus distinct product types at large tree size demand strong structural reductions;rough CF3300.
priorityReason: Offers advanced tree-distance uniqueness and distinct-color aggregation;useful enrichment after standard rerooting and diameter work.
learningObjective: Offers advanced tree-distance uniqueness and distinct-color aggregation;useful enrichment after standard rerooting and diameter work.

title: Ovenmasters
ratingBasis: Large arrival-order reconstruction with missing frustrated bakers and lexicographically smallest output is harder than forward simulation;rough CF2600 for full output requirements.
priorityReason: Reconstructing an order from greedy process traces teaches dependency reasoning and lexicographic choice;useful after standard topological ordering.
learningObjective: Reconstructing an order from greedy process traces teaches dependency reasoning and lexicographic choice;useful after standard topological ordering.

title: Biscuits
ratingBasis: The forbid-one-choice game plus repeated weight changes requires structural compression beyond static game DP;rough CF3000 for the full dynamic task.
priorityReason: A useful advanced progression from a minimax recurrence to maintaining its result under point updates.
learningObjective: A useful advanced progression from a minimax recurrence to maintaining its result under point updates.

title: Census
ratingBasis: Independent instances with sparse unknown IDs,one-bit shared writes and a strict full-score day budget demand sophisticated encoding;rough CF3300,not the easier positive-score variant.
priorityReason: Offers distributed information aggregation and collision-free communication practice,but the multi-process protocol is specialized enrichment.
learningObjective: Offers distributed information aggregation and collision-free communication practice,but the multi-process protocol is specialized enrichment.

title: Fox Families
ratingBasis: Discovering all relevant component merges without enumerating every containing pair is the principal scaling challenge;rough CF2600.
priorityReason: Connects interval containment to incremental connected components and efficient merging;strong practice after ordinary DSU and interval sorting.
learningObjective: Connects interval containment to incremental connected components and efficient merging;strong practice after ordinary DSU and interval sorting.

title: Seating Plan
ratingBasis: Recover a hidden order up to reversal using triple spans,with a much tighter full-score budget than the allowed maximum;rough CF3300 for full score.
priorityReason: Develops reconstruction from indirect range measurements and query economy;valuable advanced interactive enrichment.
learningObjective: Develops reconstruction from indirect range measurements and query economy;valuable advanced interactive enrichment.

title: Lego Wall
ratingBasis: Counting only connected tilings with a large area bound needs stronger recurrence acceleration than small-width profile enumeration;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: Teaches separating all arrangements from connected arrangements and exploiting different dimension regimes.
learningObjective: Teaches separating all arrangements from connected arrangements and exploiting different dimension regimes.

title: Social Engineering
ratingBasis: A no-repeated-edge walk with one adversarial vertex and a large graph calls for structural winning-strategy reasoning;rough CF2900.
priorityReason: An interesting graph-game exercise in exploiting structure and coordinating a team against one adversary.
learningObjective: An interesting graph-game exercise in exploiting structure and coordinating a team against one adversary.

title: Tourists
ratingBasis: Moving index ranges of tourists while preserving individual cumulative scores needs more than independent LCA calls;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: Combines tree distance queries,bulk relocation and lazy per-location event accounting;useful advanced aggregation practice.
learningObjective: Combines tree distance queries,bulk relocation and lazy per-location event accounting;useful advanced aggregation practice.

title: Chika Wants to Cheat
ratingBasis: Encoding tens of millions of identities in rotation-invariant segment patterns requires careful orbit/capacity construction;rough CF3300 for full constraints.
priorityReason: Teaches symmetry-invariant encoding and canonical representations;useful enrichment outside the core algorithm sequence.
learningObjective: Teaches symmetry-invariant encoding and canonical representations;useful enrichment outside the core algorithm sequence.

title: Bikes vs Cars
ratingBasis: Simultaneously realizing two all-pairs widest-path matrices under complementary edge widths is substantially harder than standard MST queries;rough CF3100.
priorityReason: Extends bottleneck-path and spanning-tree ideas to inverse graph construction with two coupled capacity systems.
learningObjective: Extends bottleneck-path and spanning-tree ideas to inverse graph construction with two coupled capacity systems.

title: Sopsug
ratingBasis: Forced directed edges plus complement-like allowed edges require structural checks and efficient construction rather than dense enumeration;rough CF2700.
priorityReason: Good practice in validating forced structure and building a directed spanning solution when forbidden edges are sparse.
learningObjective: Good practice in validating forced structure and building a directed spanning solution when forbidden edges are sparse.

title: Guessing Game
ratingBasis: Two-run online encoding with an adversarial final symbol and at most two guesses is especially difficult at the full-score alphabet bound;rough CF3500 for full score,not any accepted partial score.
priorityReason: A challenging communication/encoding puzzle illustrating adversarial online information;specialized enrichment rather than a standard prerequisite.
learningObjective: A challenging communication/encoding puzzle illustrating adversarial online information;specialized enrichment rather than a standard prerequisite.

title: Lanterns
ratingBasis: All possible starting purchases and combined altitude-range coverage make naive shortest paths over owned subsets infeasible;rough CF3300.
priorityReason: Offers advanced reachability-state compression with purchasable resources and interval coverage;best reserved for experienced students.
learningObjective: Offers advanced reachability-state compression with purchasable resources and interval coverage;best reserved for experienced students.

title: Angry Cows
ratingBasis: Separating cow areas while keeping all hiking areas connected adds a nontrivial feasibility/construction step after shortest paths;rough CF2800.
priorityReason: Combines multi-source distance modelling with a connectivity-preserving separator and minimax threshold reasoning.
learningObjective: Combines multi-source distance modelling with a connectivity-preserving separator and minimax threshold reasoning.

title: Garage
ratingBasis: Small capacity permits straightforward simulation;careful arrival/departure state is the main challenge;rough CF1200.
priorityReason: A clear introductory event simulation combining FIFO waiting and smallest-free-resource allocation.
learningObjective: A clear introductory event simulation combining FIFO waiting and smallest-free-resource allocation.

title: Raisins
ratingBasis: Four rectangle boundaries and both cut directions create a larger DP than one-dimensional splitting;rough CF2100.
priorityReason: A natural progression from interval DP to rectangle DP with constant-time subrectangle sums.
learningObjective: A natural progression from interval DP to rectangle DP with constant-time subrectangle sums.

title: Salesman
ratingBasis: Large event count,asymmetric linear travel costs and same-day sweeps require several coordinated optimizations;rough CF2800.
priorityReason: Excellent advanced DP optimization with directional movement costs and careful same-time event handling.
learningObjective: Excellent advanced DP optimization with directional movement costs and careful same-time event handling.

title: Quality Of Living
ratingBasis: Binary search plus two-dimensional prefix/window aggregation scales beyond maintaining every window median directly;rough CF2200.
priorityReason: A strong decision-problem example:turn a sliding-window median objective into thresholded rectangle counts.
learningObjective: A strong decision-problem example:turn a sliding-window median objective into thresholded rectangle counts.

title: Traffic
ratingBasis: Subtree/complement weights and large tree traversal require careful implementation,but only one core structural idea;rough CF1800.
priorityReason: An accessible weighted-centroid problem that connects subtree sums with balancing every component at once.
learningObjective: An accessible weighted-centroid problem that connects subtree sums with balancing every component at once.

title: Dancing Elephants
ratingBasis: Maintaining ordered positions and rebuilding local jump/coverage summaries is significantly harder than the static scan;rough CF2900.
priorityReason: Extends static greedy interval covering to dynamically moving points;useful advanced block-decomposition practice.
learningObjective: Extends static greedy interval covering to dynamically moving points;useful advanced block-decomposition practice.

title: Ideal city
ratingBasis: A connected hole-free cell region may still have long detours;the full problem needs a non-obvious structural reduction;rough CF2800.
priorityReason: Teaches compression of geometric connectivity and counting pair contributions instead of all-pairs searches.
learningObjective: Teaches compression of geometric connectivity and counting pair contributions instead of all-pairs searches.

title: Last supper
ratingBasis: The offline eviction rule is supplied,but encoding enough advice under a bit budget adds a substantial layer;rough CF2900.
priorityReason: Connects optimal offline caching with a compact advice stream that lets an online process reproduce good decisions.
learningObjective: Connects optimal offline caching with a compact advice stream that lets an online process reproduce good decisions.

title: Holiday
ratingBasis: A starting position in the interior and choices on both sides make top-value range selection and monotone optimization nontrivial;rough CF3100.
priorityReason: A useful advanced optimization exercise separating movement budget from selecting valuable visited locations.
learningObjective: A useful advanced optimization exercise separating movement budget from selecting valuable visited locations.

title: Teams
ratingBasis: Many independent queries over the same students need stronger preprocessing than rerunning ordinary greedy matching;rough CF3200.
priorityReason: Builds from interval eligibility matching to efficient repeated team-feasibility queries.
learningObjective: Builds from interval eligibility matching to efficient repeated team-feasibility queries.

title: Towns
ratingBasis: Recovering a hub radius and balance information without reconstructing the hidden weighted tree is demanding;rough CF3200 for the full query-limited task.
priorityReason: Develops tree-metric inference from distance queries,but hidden internal vertices and strict query economy make it specialized.
learningObjective: Develops tree-metric inference from distance queries,but hidden internal vertices and strict query economy make it specialized.

title: Roller Coaster Railroad
ratingBasis: Choosing section order and connecting speed transitions needs an unusual graph/sweep reduction;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: Illustrates transforming sequencing costs into connectivity and balancing on ordered values.
learningObjective: Illustrates transforming sequencing costs into connectivity and balancing on ordered values.

title: Ancient Books
ratingBasis: Minimum direct book displacement is only a lower bound;joining reachable cycle regions from the starting position is the harder part;rough CF3100.
priorityReason: Connects permutation cycles with spatial interval expansion and extra travel costs;valuable advanced modelling.
learningObjective: Connects permutation cycles with spatial interval expansion and extra travel costs;valuable advanced modelling.

title: Mechanical Doll
ratingBasis: Producing an exact repeated sequence with few alternating switches requires a non-obvious circuit design;rough CF2900 for strong/full-score construction.
priorityReason: A memorable binary switching-network construction with state-reset invariants;specialized enrichment after basic recursive constructions.
learningObjective: A memorable binary switching-network construction with state-reset invariants;specialized enrichment after basic recursive constructions.

title: Split the Attractions
ratingBasis: Exact group sizes with only two groups required connected create subtle existence and construction cases;rough CF3300.
priorityReason: Offers advanced connected-partition construction and DFS structure reasoning;best after ordinary graph decomposition.
learningObjective: Offers advanced connected-partition construction and DFS structure reasoning;best after ordinary graph decomposition.

title: Packing Biscuits
ratingBasis: Count all attainable equal bag tastiness values without enumerating the large numeric range;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: Useful binary-resource counting practice connecting carries,capacity prefixes and counting feasible target values.
learningObjective: Useful binary-resource counting practice connecting carries,capacity prefixes and counting feasible target values.

title: Stations
ratingBasis: Two-stage memory separation and compact labels need a traversal-based ordering invariant;rough CF2500.
priorityReason: An excellent tree-labeling exercise:encode routing information in labels instead of carrying the original graph.
learningObjective: An excellent tree-labeling exercise:encode routing information in labels instead of carrying the original graph.

title: Fountain Parks
ratingBasis: Selecting roads while assigning distinct adjacent benches adds a geometric invariant beyond finding any spanning tree;rough CF2700.
priorityReason: Combines grid parity,spanning connectivity and collision-free local assignments in a constructive graph problem.
learningObjective: Combines grid parity,spanning connectivity and collision-free local assignments in a constructive graph problem.

title: Rarest Insects
ratingBasis: Unknown equivalence classes and a scored operation budget need careful threshold strategy and reuse;rough CF2900 for strong/full-score performance.
priorityReason: Teaches extracting minimum group size from a maximum-frequency oracle and controlling insertion/removal query costs.
learningObjective: Teaches extracting minimum group size from a maximum-frequency oracle and controlling insertion/removal query costs.

title: Shortcut
ratingBasis: A million-node line with side branches and arbitrary shortcut endpoints requires strong decision-check compression;rough CF3500.
priorityReason: An advanced minimax network design problem that turns all-pairs diameter constraints into structured inequalities.
learningObjective: An advanced minimax network design problem that turns all-pairs diameter constraints into structured inequalities.

title: Longest Trip
ratingBasis: Combining path maintenance/merging with a tight full-score query budget is substantially harder than reading a dense adjacency matrix;rough CF3100.
priorityReason: Shows how a strong local density guarantee makes a normally hard longest-path task constructible with set-connectivity queries.
learningObjective: Shows how a strong local density guarantee makes a normally hard longest-path task constructible with set-connectivity queries.

title: Message
ratingBasis: Encoding enough payload while teaching the receiver the safe structure within the full-score packet budget requires a careful construction;rough CF3000.
priorityReason: Develops reliable communication when only the sender knows which channel positions are trustworthy.
learningObjective: Develops reliable communication when only the sender knows which channel positions are trustworthy.

title: Registration System
ratingBasis: Official Codeforces rating field from the retained successful API snapshot;contest points are not used as difficulty.
priorityReason: Practical map-based name allocation teaches lookup,duplicate handling and maintaining a small counter per key.
learningObjective: Practical map-based name allocation teaches lookup,duplicate handling and maintaining a small counter per key.

title: Regular Bracket Sequence
ratingBasis: Official Codeforces rating field from the retained successful API snapshot;contest points are not used as difficulty.
priorityReason: A clean greedy bracket-matching scan teaches maintaining unmatched openings and recognizing what can be safely paired.
learningObjective: A clean greedy bracket-matching scan teaches maintaining unmatched openings and recognizing what can be safely paired.

title: Pashmak and Flowers
ratingBasis: Official Codeforces rating field from the retained successful API snapshot;contest points are not used as difficulty.
priorityReason: Useful introductory extreme-value counting with a separate all-equal case;reinforces careful combinatorial counting.
learningObjective: Useful introductory extreme-value counting with a separate all-equal case;reinforces careful combinatorial counting.

title: Interesting drink
ratingBasis: Official Codeforces rating field from the retained successful API snapshot;contest points are not used as difficulty.
priorityReason: A direct sort-once,answer-many-count-queries exercise that makes upper-bound semantics concrete.
learningObjective: A direct sort-once,answer-many-count-queries exercise that makes upper-bound semantics concrete.

title: Jzzhu and Sequences
ratingBasis: Official Codeforces rating field from the retained successful API snapshot;contest points are not used as difficulty.
